notes.title: New Recycling Branches UPDATE 🌱♻️🌍💚
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="IXZ1MCUhFTQ;full"][/previewyoutube]👷‍♀️ Hi Junkyard fans! 👷‍♂️

We have a fresh update for you with lots of cool new features! 🚀 The junkyard is changing for the better, and recycling is reaching new heights. New possibilities, more space, and a few surprises await you in the game—take a look below and see for yourself! ♻️🔥

🎮 Gameplay:
🔹 Added new waste processing branches:
 
 🔵Paper – paper baler producing paper bales
 🟡Plastic – plastic baler producing plastic bales
 🟠Wood – wood shredder producing sawdust bags

🔹 More space at the junkyard: moved the delivery truck outside the area and removed the market building.
🔹 Added a laptop that gives you access to the market and allows to purchase machines, tools, and other objects. After purchasing, a package appears next to the warehouse; it can be picked up, unpacked, and the machine can be placed anywhere.
🔹 Added the ability to move containers for paper, plastic, metal, and mixed waste.
🔹 Changed wholesale selling: from now on, selling requires driving into the zone in front of a container of a given type.
🔹 Added the option to stop trash deliveries after selecting the appropriate upgrade in the upgrades panel.


🛠 Bug Fixes & Improvements:
🔹 Fixed a bug causing machines to sink into the ground.
🔹 Fixed a bug causing machines to tip over.
🔹 Fixed a bug causing the crane magnet to malfunction.
🔹 Fixed a bug with objects falling under machines.
🔹 Fixed a bug preventing items from being placed into machines directly from the cart.
🔹 Fixed a bug allowing a bed frame to be placed in the cart.
🔹 Fixed a bug preventing a metal table from being placed into the metal crusher.
🔹 Fixed incorrectly displayed control hints.
🔹 Fixed a bug with cart driving sound remaining after exiting the cart.
🔹 Improved and updated translations.
🔹 Improved and changed fonts.
🔹Improved truck behavior on exit maps – the truck should no longer run over objects and get stuck.
🔹 Improved navigation in panels when using a gamepad.
🔹 Improved naming of furniture parts – corrected left/right labels.

Oh and Junkyard Builder is also coming to PlayStation on October 21st

notes.title: Fixes after FREEDOM UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Thanks for all your feedback after the Freedom Update!
This hotfix addresses several bugs and quality-of-life issues

👷‍♂️ 1.4.1 - New Update is Live!

🛠 Bug Fixes & Improvements:

🔵Fixed missing button icons – all control icons should now display correctly. If you still see a triangle symbol, it means that the action doesn't have a key assigned. Just go to the keybinding menu and assign a key, or reset your controls to default.

🔵Fixed an issue where machines could disappear during placement.

🔵Adjusted the cash drop chance from trash bags – it should now feel more balanced.

🔵Fixed a bug where the upgrade panel would show up while placing machines.

🔵Fixed glyphs not displaying properly in the upgrade panel.

🔵Fixed an issue where the cart wouldn't auto-pick up items of the "other" type.

🔵Improved the keybinding panel – now with section headers for better clarity.

🔵Fixed a bug where objects could fall through the map.

🔵Fixed incorrect translation of Droffe bumpers – the front and rear bumpers are now labeled correctly.

🔵Fixed a bug where the crane could teleport when placed near the scrapyard border.

🔵Fixed a bug allowing players to enter the market while moving machines.


Have fun 🚚
Junkyard Team

notes.title: Junkyard DEMO also has an update 😃 An option for all those undecided!
notes.notes:
👷‍♀️ Hi Junkyard fans! 👷‍♂️

🎉 Demo Update – We heard you!
You've asked — we listened! Many of you felt that the original Junkyard Builder demo was too limited and didn’t provide enough time to truly experience the game. We've taken your feedback seriously, and we're excited to announce a major update to the demo version!

🛠 What’s changed?
⏱ Extended playtime:
The demo session time has been increased from 30 to 60 minutes!
Now you have a full hour to dive into the junkyard, experiment with mechanics, and see what Junkyard Builder is all about.

🔓 The demo now features the complete version of the game — no content restrictions!

All core features are available, including:
🔹Full object assembly system
🔹All three outbound maps
🔹Delivery truck included
And much more — everything that's available in the Early Access version!

💾 Progress carries over:
If you decide to purchase the full Early Access version after playing the demo, your progress will be fully saved - pick up right where you left off! This update is a direct response to community feedback, and we hope it provides new players with a much better and more complete experience.
Try the demo now and let us know what you think!

Have fun!
Junkyard Team 🚚
